images.caption:
Acadia National Park, Sieur de Monts.

Thanks for the Explore! This juvenile porcupine was on the side of a carriage road in the park, just eating. Another group of hikers had seen it before me. Then, a bigger group of tourists came by, and a ranger asked from afar, "Is that what I think it is?" I nodded "Yes", but now I think she was probably asking whether it was a bear.
images.alt:
